description: Saves a Gmail draft in the signed-in person's mailbox for a Clio matter, CCing the Clio maildrop so it files when sent. Does not send. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

cc.description: Extra CC email(s), comma-separated. The matter maildrop is added automatically.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

is_html.description: Body is HTML. Defaults to plain text.

matter_id.description: Clio matter id (digits) from find_matter or list_open_matters. Not the display number.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

name: draft_matter_email
title: Draft matter email
